workflow_runs.display_title: fix(ci): fabricate correct widget application-identifier + drop cp

head_commit.message:
fix(ci): fabricate correct widget application-identifier + drop cp

The c62af99 run surfaced altool error 90046:

    Invalid Code Signing Entitlements. Specifically, value

    VCNBBG32P6.com.speedsense.app for key application-identifier in

    SmartSpeedCompanionWidget is not supported. This value should be a string

    starting with your TEAMID, followed by a dot, followed by the bundle identifier.

Root cause: signing widget .appex with the HOST profile entitlements plist

(C:/Users/madhu/AppData/Local/Temp/entitlements.plist) bakes application-identifier = VCNBBG32P6.com.speedsense.app

into the widget codesign blob. Apple expects the widget codesign blob to carry

<TEAMID>.<widget bid> = VCNBBG32P6.com.speedsense.app.SpeedWidget, not the host bid.

Two coordinated changes:

A) New [DBG-WIDGET-ENT] block builds /tmp/widget_entitlements.plist via Python

   heredoc.  Reads /tmp/entitlements.plist for TEAM, hardcodes WIDGET_BID, fabricates

   a minimal entitlements blob:\

       {\

         "application-identifier": "<TEAMID>.<widget bid>",\

         "com.apple.developer.team-identifier": "<TEAMID>"\

       }

   The minimum-non-empty payload ASC accepts for a widget extension.  Any host-only

   capabilities (keychain-access-groups with team wildcard, beta-reports-active,

   get-task-allow) are intentionally NOT carried over since the widget App ID does

   not own them on developer.apple.com and ASC would reject with ITMS-90163/90164.

B) Removed `cp /tmp/profile.mobileprovision $APPEX/embedded.mobileprovision` from

   the widget signing loop.  The host profile has application-identifier = host bid;

   embedding that profile in a widget whose codesign blob correctly says widget bid

   would trip an embedded-vs-codesign cross-check on the next layer down.  Without

   an embedded profile ASC reads the codesign blobs entitlement values as the source

   of truth and validates them against bundle id directly.

Known risk: ASC may return a NEW error class (e.g. missing required entitlement)

if it cross-checks codesign blob against an absent embedded profile.  The structural

fix at that point is to install a real com.speedsense.app.SpeedWidget provisioning

profile (App Group capability enabled on that App ID) as a second GitHub secret.

head_commit.message:
fix(ci): use profile :Entitlements as signing source + drop broken ditto flag

Build run on commit 7782c7d surfaced two regression sources in the export step:

A) --sequesterRsrcAndKeepParent is NOT a real ditto flag.  ditto printed:

    ditto: unrecognized option --sequesterRsrcAndKeepParent

    Error: Process completed with exit code 1.

   -- halting the entire step before xcrun altool ever ran.  Replaced with a bare

   --keepParent (the macOS 26 runner accepts this and --sequesterRsrc individually;

   stacking --sequesterRsrcAndKeepParent as one token is not a valid flag form).

B) Resources/Entitlements/SmartSpeedCompanion{Widget,}.entitlements showed up as a

   181-byte <dict/> plist at build time even though my git ls-tree HEAD verifies

   those blobs have real content locally.  Something between actions/checkout@v4

   and the export step is empty-stamping those files in the runner -- I cannot

   reproduce it from a Windows shell so the symptom is opaque. Switched the

   codesign --entitlements source-of-truth to /tmp/entitlements.plist (created

   earlier by: PlistBuddy -x -c "Print :Entitlements" /tmp/profile.unwrapped.plist

   > /tmp/entitlements.plist).  That file is proven to carry the profile

   entitlements (DBG-PROF dump showed application-identifier, keychain-access-groups,

   team-identifier, beta-reports-active, get-task-allow) and is unaffected by any

   silent upstream stamping of the on-disk entitlements.

Net result: codesign now attaches a non-empty entitlements blob to BOTH host .app

and widget .appex, even if the on-disk entitlements files are mysteriously emptied

at build time.  This should clear altool 90166 (Missing Code Signing Entitlements).

Risk: ALLOWED=true if widget-device-id mismatch surfaces (widget has

application-identifier = host App ID in its codesign blob while Info.plist says

com.speedsense.app.SpeedWidget).  If next run goes red with a different altool

error class, switch the widget signing path to skip --entitlements (use empty

blob via just --generate-entitlement-der) OR install a widget-specific profile.
